field_edits.updated_text: Liver is mildly enlarged, measuring approximately 17 cm in craniocaudal span. Few small simple hepatic cysts are noted. No definite solid focal hepatic lesion is identified. The remaining liver signal is normal.

Right kidney is ectopic (pelvic in location) and malrotated. Few simple cortical cysts are seen in both kidneys. No definite solid renal mass is described. The left kidney is otherwise normal in size and position.

impression:

Few simple hepatic cysts.

Few simple bilateral renal cortical cysts.

No significant abnormality of the gallbladder, CBD, spleen or pancreas.
